Oumaima Mamoun is a quantitative analyst at EY Advisory in Paris with an engineering background in financial engineering and an MSc in Quantitative Finance.

Her interests include derivatives pricing, stochastic modelling, numerical methods and quantitative software development.

This publication collects independently developed research notes and reproducible experiments. It does not publish employer or client material. Views are her own.
